purpose: Document primary local registry/custody evidence and bounded anonymous full-geometry discovery.
assessment: A primary local registration center is established, but the searches and source inspection did not identify an anonymous full-polygon parcel endpoint. No geometry query was made because the official material located describes service/registration, not a public feature layer.
registryAssessment: The official Zhuji Natural Resources and Planning Bureau posts the charter of the Zhuji Real Estate Registration Service Center, a city-level public institution managed by the bureau and responsible for registration of land, houses, forests, and rural land-use rights. This establishes local registration custody/service, not anonymous geometry access.
